name: evidence-deflator
description: Is that trading record skill, or luck? Adds the hosted hyperliquid_wallet MCP tool, a skill that checks wallets, backtests and track records, and a hook that counts every backtest the agent runs so the one it reports has to clear the best-of-N bar. Optional: a hook that sends orders through the agent gate instead of straight to a broker's MCP tools.

backtest_pattern.title: Backtest command pattern
backtest_pattern.description: Regular expression (case-insensitive) for shell commands that count as one backtest run. Leave empty for the built-in list (backtest, backtrader, vectorbt, zipline, freqtrade backtesting, lean backtest, qlib, optuna...).

direct_order_pattern.title: Order tools that must go through the gate
direct_order_pattern.description: Regular expression (case-insensitive) for MCP tool names that place orders, e.g. (place|submit|create|replace)_?\w*order. Matching calls from any server whose name does not contain the gate server name are refused, and the agent is told to use the gate's place_order. Empty (the default) turns this off.

gate_server.title: Gate server name
gate_server.description: Calls from MCP servers whose name contains this are never refused. Default: gate.
